page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines. Small lines at the top, a large centred title in the upper middle, smaller lines below it, a short imprint near the foot. Library stamps and a handwritten shelf mark lie over the lower half and are not printed text.
page.notes: The title page is very faded; only the large title lines are visible as shapes, and the individual words cannot be read reliably, so each line is marked illegible. The stamps (a red round library stamp, an oval stamp reading "Biblioteka Uniwersytecka ... w Toruniu", cancelled) and the handwritten shelf mark "Ob. 6. II. 3071" are not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible.
